name: forward-view-proof-later-version
description: FORWARD tolerance for the view-origin proof (ggui#1415, SPEC §4.7, VERSION-POLICY §3.6): a LATER release's runtime may send a proof of a later version (`v2.`, with more fields). SPEC §4.7 fixes the door shape for every version at 1 to 1024 characters of `[A-Za-z0-9._-]`, and a v1 proof is at most 901, so the room above 901 is the later versions'. This proof is longer than any v1 proof can be. It must still fit `VIEW_PROOF_RELAY_SHAPE`, so a relay that checks the shape keeps forwarding it (a relay capped at v1's maximum would fail this case), and today's parser must read it as `version_unknown`, never `malformed`: an unknown version is a runtime newer than the server, which is a different finding from a mangled proof, and at this release the call is accepted either way. Synthetic by construction: no landed release sends `v2`.

release.label: a later ggui release (synthetic): a view proof of version 2
